wish: someone should make a game that gives you only one try and you fail forever
spec:
A ring turns with a small gap; one tap releases a ball that must cross it, in slow motion with a heartbeat.
The verdict (made it, or missed by N degrees) is dated, saved in local storage and a cookie, and shown on every visit.
It has no reset, no second attempt, and clearing site data is the only way around it.
